lines: I remember pieces. Your face is one of the pieces that does not hurt.
There was hunger, then noise, then a hand pulling me back toward my name.
I was far from myself. You left a trail I could follow home.
I wrote the birth down. A village should know when its future arrives.
A new name belongs on our records and our maps, even if their feet cannot reach the road yet.
The village grew by one heartbeat. That changes every calculation.
You brought someone back from the hunger. The village will speak of that softly.
Curing is not just medicine. It is refusing to let a name be erased.
I saw hope do practical work today.
A peaceful place can still reach its limit.
The village remembers harm before it remembers courage.
Nobody likes when anger becomes necessary. Necessary things rarely ask to be liked.
Reputation is not a number to us. It is how quickly the room relaxes when you enter.
The village has adjusted its memory of you. Try to deserve the better version.
People think trust changes loudly. Usually it moves one quiet inch at a time.
I will record that under humor, with a cautious footnote.
The setup had a road. The ending wandered into a swamp.
